integrity: The 2026 primary source was inspected through the harmonic Schwarzian definitions, affine balancing, the realization lemma, the sharp pre-Schwarzian shadow estimate, and the explicit Schwarzian open problem. The new proof derives an exact Schwarzian-difference identity, proves the required second-order Schwarz-Pick bound directly, and uses an explicit globally univalent balanced lower witness. No numerical experiment is used.
scientific_limitations: The theorem determines the sharp small-dilatation exponent for the affine-balanced Schwarzian analytic-shadow problem but not the exact sharp function or its leading coefficient. The fixed-M asymptotic statement assumes M>0 is independent of k.
title: Quadratic Schwarzian shadow law for affine-balanced harmonic maps
